detail: Story card Given: "spawn near an existing cluster member within a group radius". Diagonal dir {±1,±1} × dist 4 or 5 = Euclidean 5.66/7.07 > radius_tiles 5, so ~8/24 biased dir×dist combos land outside the anchor's radius; such spawns become isolated singletons in the derived view unless another member is coincidentally near, inflating the isolated minority beyond the bias coin and falsifying the PR body's "JOINS the estate" claim.
recommended_fix: Scale the diagonal step (e.g. dist√2⁻¹, integer floor) or clamp Euclidean distance to radius_tiles so every biased candidate lands within the group radius; pin with a test asserting each biased spawn is within radius of a cluster member.
